name: Lesencetomaj (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and red in the ratio 3:1:3, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lesencetomaj: a red and yellow shield with a griffin, a bunch of grapes and an arrow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
